14 Milan hotels, each priced on every booking site we recorded for it. Prices on this page are per night, all-in where the sites reported taxes and fees; the study's count below uses the before-tax prices of its CSV. One snapshot on September 29, 2026 for Nov 3 to Nov 5, 2 adults, US market, USD. Prices change daily.

Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Milan hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 29, 2026 snapshot, at 9 of the 15 Milan hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Booking.com at 4, the hotel's own site at 2, Agoda at 1, Billabook.com at 1 and Vio.com at 1. These are the Milan rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 10 of the 14 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Booking.com at 4, the hotel's own site at 3, Billabook.com at 1, Ostello Bello Grande - Milano Centrale at 1, Super.com at 1 and Vio.com at 1 (a tie counts for each site). At the other 4, no site was 5% or more below it. The two counts differ: at 1 of the hotels listed below, the all-in prices put the gap on the other side of the 5% line, and the study also counts the 1 named below that are not listed on this page. Taxes and fees at Milan hotels

At the 8 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 15% ($19 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 9% at Babila Hostel & Bistrot to 30% at My Guest Milan Suite. At 6 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
